topic: HRRRv4 ThompsonAero aerosol state-source identity and low-cost L1 harness boundary

lockedFacts: is_aerosol_aware becomes true when nwfa2d, nwfa and nifa optional arrays are present
thompson_init checks existing NWFA/NIFA and fills basic vertical profiles when the corresponding field maximum is below eps
fallback profile construction is source behavior, not an external observation
the aerosol-aware path still uses the CCN activation lookup table
THOMPSONAERO initialization passes NWFA2D, NWFA and NIFA arrays to thompson_init
array presence and state-source provenance are separate properties
SCM is a 3x3 periodic single-column harness with no horizontal gradients unless explicitly forced
input_sounding contains terrain/surface plus z,u,v,theta,qv and does not define aerosol IC/BC fields
baseline SCM is mp_physics=2, ra_lw_physics=1, ra_sw_physics=1
baseline SCM is not a ThompsonAero effective-radius validation harness without explicit configuration changes
CONUS uses mp_physics=28 and RRTMG longwave/shortwave 4/4
CONUS explicitly sets use_aero_icbc=.true. and use_rap_aero_icbc=.true.
operational aerosol state-source identity is therefore not the same as the SCM fallback-profile identity
WRF test/run linking includes CCN_ACTIVATE.BIN as an auxiliary runtime dependency
SCM build target uses the shipped em_scm_xy ideal-case inputs
for WRFV3.9+ use_aero_icbc=false uses assumed vertical profiles of water- and ice-friendly aerosols
external climatological aerosol IC/BC is an optional state-source route, not a prerequisite for entering the aerosol-aware scheme
